query:
UPDATE requests.requests r
                SET request_number = n.rn
               FROM (
                        SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                                   PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
                               ) AS rn
                          FROM requests.requests
                    ) n
              WHERE n.id = r.id
                AND r.request_number IS DISTINCT FROM n.rn
